home.h1Before: We build the store. Then we build
home.h1Em: the thing that keeps it moving.
home.sub: X Dev is a small studio for founders who don't have time to run their own marketing by hand. We design and build e-commerce stores end to end, then wire up the automated content systems that keep the brand posting, on-brand, every day — with nobody at a dashboard.

module1.title: Store Build
module1.desc: A full e-commerce store, designed and built from scratch — storefront, checkout, payments, and launch, ready for real customers on day one.
module1.includesValue: Design, storefront build, checkout, payment setup, launch QA

module2.title: Automation Retainer
module2.desc: An on-brand character or voice, designed once and set to run — scheduled posts and fresh captions across platforms, without you touching a dashboard.
module2.includesValue: Character/voice design, content system, scheduled posting, monthly refresh

case.name: Snoutzzz
case.p1Before: Snoutzzz is a pet-comfort store we designed, built, and launched from the ground up — storefront, checkout, and a brand mascot named Noodlez. It's a live, working store, not a mockup:
case.p2: After launch, we built the automation layer: a posting system that writes and publishes in Noodlez's voice every day, across two platforms, without anyone at a keyboard.
case.p3: The store is newly live and still building its audience — everything below is what's actually shipped and running today, not a projection.

case2.name: TheOhioGirl
case2.p1Before: TheOhioGirl is a portfolio and shop site for a Brooklyn muralist and painter — a Next.js build with an image-optimized gallery for her work and an integrated print shop. It's live now:
case2.p2: Artwork is served through Vercel blob storage so the gallery loads fast across devices, from mobile browsing to full-screen desktop viewing.
case2.p3: Gallery, shop, and contact all live in one place — no separate platforms to manage.

step1.title: Discovery
step1.desc: A short call to scope the build or the retainer — what you need, what you already have, and what it'll take.

step2.title: Build
step2.desc: Design and development with weekly check-ins, so nothing arrives as a surprise at the end.

step3.title: Launch
step3.desc: The store goes live, or the automation goes live and starts posting — handed off, running on its own.

footer.line: Have a store that needs building, or a brand that needs to show up every day without you?
